details: The agent faithfully executed the planned reanalysis in analysis_info.json. Both Task1 and Task2 were run using the provided Python translation of the Welch two-sample t-test comparing totinc across caste groups (ST/SC vs others), using the original household.dta. The outputs include t, df, p-value, group means, SDs, and sample sizes, matching the specified comparison metrics. Both tasks produced consistent results and were reported in execution_results.json. Minor note: the artifact file paths in execution_results.json use capitalized Task names (e.g., data/outputs/Task1_ttest_caste_income.json), while the actual files are lowercase (data/outputs/task1_ttest_caste_income.json). Aligning case in paths would improve consistency, but this does not affect the substantive fidelity of execution.
